sprinklers: Required in new one- and two-family houses unless the county opted out (Maryland state law)

plumbing.name: Maryland State Plumbing Code (State Board of Plumbing; historically NSPC-based); counties/cities adopt IPC locally (e.g. Hagerstown 2021 IPC)

elsewhere: Maryland Building Performance Standards apply statewide (2021 IRC/IECC with State amendments, enforcement required by 2024-05-29); each county and municipality may add local amendments, so check locally. State law also requires fire sprinklers in new one- and two-family dwellings unless a local jurisdiction opts out (sprinklers not a tracked key).
notes: 2021 IRC/IECC with COMAR amendments effective 2023-05-29; specific State amendments to tracked numbers not itemized. NEC edition and plumbing model not confirmed.
